name: Nanaka
message: 「Today was peaceful all day, wasn't it」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Walking home with you like usual like this, it feels like Re-Crea and demons don't even exist」

name: Synn
message: 「Those guys from the Delicious Food Squad are waiting when you get home, aren't they?」

name: Synn
message: 「And I still see Sally-chan around too」

name: Paqy
message: 「Hey, hey. You've got way too little sense of danger」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I mean, we're fighting demons and all, so I know it's not normal, but...」

name: Synn
message: 「Still, I wish things would just end peacefully like this」
If they do, I feel like there'll be less chance of me having to reveal my true identity as the Demon Lord.
Nothing happening really is for the best.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Even if a stuffed panda says that...」

name: Paqy
message: 「Would you believe the great me if I were made of superalloy or something?」

name: Synn
message: 「For now, we just have to do our best for the Holy Night Festival」
